name: Santorini
description: Famed for its cliffside white-washed villages, blue-domed churches, dramatic volcanic caldera views, and world-class romantic sunsets.

name: Maldives
description: Tropical paradise of overwater bungalows, pristine white sand islands, crystal clear turquoise lagoons, and abundant marine life.

name: New York
description: The city that never sleeps. Iconic skyscrapers, Broadway theater district, Michelin gastronomy, Central Park, and world-class shopping.

name: Kyoto
description: Japan's cultural heart. Historic Shinto shrines, serenity-filled Zen gardens, traditional bamboo groves, geisha districts, and Kaiseki cuisine.

name: Swiss Alps
description: Majestic snow-covered Matterhorn mountain peaks, luxury ski resorts, thermal spa sanctuaries, and pristine alpine wilderness.

name: Bali
description: Island of the Gods. Emerald terraced rice paddies, sacred jungle temples, world-class surf breaks, and holistic wellness retreats.
